en:
There's no point in wandering around...
I should stay in my room and relax.

<CLT=cltMIND>I tried to get myself into the right
mindset for the final battle...
<CLT=cltMIND>While I was meditating on it...
<CLT=cltMIND>it became nighttime before I knew it.
We go at dawn.

<CLT=cltMIND>I won't hesitate anymore.
Kaito has taught me...

I have to do it.
To live, to find a reason to live...
I will fight.

<CLT=cltMIND>I spent that night with that thought
nestled deep into my heart.
...Don't panic. Just stay calm and listen.

Well, if you're watching this Monokuma
Theater segment, it's already too late.

You kids might not know, but to a 100% cotton
mascot like me, hope is... Well...

The thought of seeing young people brimming
with hope, killing each other just to survive.

Watching their hope fade away... There's
nothing more despair-inducing than that...

My dear students, carrying humanity's hope...
Betraying, deceiving, and killing each other...
It makes me...oh-so sad...

Oh, how I long to see everyone's despairing
faces, soaked in blood and tears...
I've gone and done it.

<CLT=cltMIND>After that empty announcement from
Monokuma, I jumped out of bed.

Alright...here we go.
First, to the dining hall.

<CLT=cltMIND>I grabbed the charged Electrohammer
and ran out of my room.
